name: Izumozaki Neneko
source:
Neneko is a genius who is fluent in 20 different languages but is socially awkward, making it difficult for her to talk to strangers. Her stuttering doesn't make things easier either.

She has a photographic memory, which will come in handy in her work as [url=/c95244]Ikeda's[/url] assistant on Shironagasu Island.

[From [url=https://tabinomichi.jp/shironagasu/en/]official website[/url]]
